obs: "This act of 1804 has never been directly repealed. It still operates upon all the grants, concessions, &c., embraced within its provisions, except so far as these provisions may be shown to have been modified by posterior legislation."
“But the insertion of the word forever can have no legal effect. Every enactment not expressly limited in its *628duration continues,in force until repealed or abrogated by some competent power”
